description: Python toolkit for cryptocurrency market data, funding-aware backtesting, carry-strategy research, and guarded paper trading.
rules: Use Python 3.12 and uv for this package.
Keep strategy signals separate from fees, funding accounting, and execution.
Shift positions to avoid look-ahead bias in backtests.
Use the paper broker for examples; live execution requires separate explicit authorization.
Verify each venue's funding units and settlement intervals before interpreting carry results.
